symbols.read: BNBUSDT has broken below the 722.40 trigger to 721.39, but the SELL is now flagged INVALIDATED with the combined 4H+1H stance shifting from SELL to HOLD — the short setup no longer has lower-timeframe confirmation. The 4H remains bearish and a fresh bearish FVG at 726.00–726.48 now caps any bounce, keeping the near-term path down toward 686.36 intact. Bias is neutral-to-weak: a reclaim of 737.02 still invalidates the bearish structure and reopens the bullish flip toward 758.44, while the BULLISH regime keeps this a counter-trend short at best. Watch 722.40 — holding below keeps downside pressure alive, but the loss of 1H alignment means conviction is materially lower than the prior read.

The bearish short at 81,033.66 is now invalidated: price at 81,664.00 never reached the entry and the last 1H candle closed +0.55% (81,145.72→81,589.86), a bounce off the lower pivot. The combined 4H+1H regime has shifted from SELL to HOLD, and the regime tag reads BULLISH, so the prior bearish bias is revised to neutral-to-constructive. Bias is now range-hold between 81,033.66 support and 84,352.00 resistance, with no open FVGs to pull price either way. Invalidation: a clean break below 81,033.66 reopens the short toward 77,715.32, while acceptance above 84,352.00 confirms the bullish flip.

Price has pulled back from 2,471.86 to 2,412.44, sitting just above the 2,403.69 lower pivot, and the 1H trend has flipped down — the prior neutral-to-cautious-long lean is now under pressure. The 1H bull FVGs at 2,458–2,464 and 2,399–2,423 that formed the demand ladder have been consumed, replaced by an open bear FVG at 2,446–2,455 overhead, so the near-term bias shifts to cautious-short while 2,403.69 holds as the line in the sand. A sustained break below 2,403.69 confirms the bearish 4H case toward 2,227.50, while reclaiming 2,446 would neutralize the bear FVG and revive the long case. The 4H sell setup remains invalidated and combined regime reads HOLD, so this is a tactical short into support, not a trend reversal.

Bias stays bearish and the short remains invalidated: price at 103.69 is now well below the 107.16 lower pivot, so the 107.16 entry with stop 107.19 and target 100.92 still cannot be armed. What changed from the prior read is continued downside progress — price extended from 105.94 to 103.69, and the 1H has flipped back down with its last candle at 103.08→103.53, confirming the countertrend drift fully faded. With no open FVGs, there is still no structural support beneath, so the path toward 100.92 stays open. Invalidation of the bearish lean remains a reclaim of 107.16; until that prints, the bias is unchanged and nothing is live.

Price has slipped to 57.05, extending the 4H bearish structure further below the 58.41 lower pivot, and the combined signal stays HOLD — the prior neutral-to-softly-bearish bias is confirmed and now reinforced by the 1H trend flipping down. The 58.41 short entry remains expired and untriggered with stop 58.58 and target 55.37 untouched, but a fresh bearish FVG at 57.42–57.53 now sits just overhead as the nearest supply to trade against. The prior 1H resilience noted in the last read has evaporated, resolving the timeframe conflict in favor of the bears. A sustained reclaim of 58.41 still flips the read bullish toward 61.45 and kills the short thesis; rejection at the 57.42–57.53 FVG keeps 55.37 as the downside objective.

The combined read has flipped back from HOLD to BUY with the 4H still bullish, so the stalled push higher has resumed rather than failed — price recovered to 4,168.84 and the last 1H closed +0.21%, reversing the prior -0.05% slip. The bull FVG at 4,160.90–4,163.27 has been fully filled and no open FVGs remain, so the support floor that anchored the prior read is gone and price now trades on structure alone. Bias is long: the 4,217.40 upper pivot stays the upside objective while 4,141.44 holds, and the SELL setup remains invalidated with its 4,141.44 entry untouched. Invalidation is unchanged — a sustained break below 4,141.44 flips the combined read bearish and re-arms the 4,065.48 target.

Bias flips to neutral-to-short: price has lost the 1.31 lower pivot (now 1.30) and the 1H trend has turned down, so the prior neutral-to-long stance is revised — the 1.31 shelf that kept the SELL invalidated no longer holds. The bounce to 1.30 (+0.29%) is a weak counter within a down 1H, and two fresh bear FVGs at 1.3154–1.328 and 1.3283–1.3297 now cap upside, replacing the old 1.353–1.3567 fade zone as the operative resistance. The SELL from 1.31 is now live toward 1.20 with 1.37 as stop, though the BULLISH regime tag and HOLD combined read argue for confirmation rather than full conviction. Invalidation: reclaiming 1.3154–1.328 puts price back above the pivot and voids the short, reopening 1.353–1.3567 and the 1.43 pivot; holding below 1.31 keeps 1.20 in play.
